proverbs: In all the world, there is no heart for me like yours.
Whatever our souls are made of, his and mine are the same.
You are my today and all of my tomorrows.
I have found the one whom my soul loves.
Love is composed of a single soul inhabiting two bodies.
To love and be loved is to feel the sun from both sides.
Where there is love there is life.
Two souls with but a single thought, two hearts that beat as one.
Grow old along with me, the best is yet to be.
A successful marriage requires falling in love many times, always with the same person.
You are the finest, loveliest, tenderest person I have ever known.
I love you not only for what you are, but for what I am when I am with you.
Love does not consist of gazing at each other, but in looking outward together.
The best thing to hold onto in life is each other.
My heart is and always will be yours.
I choose you, today and every day.
You are my greatest adventure.
Love recognizes no barriers.
Every love story is beautiful, but ours is my favourite.
Family is not an important thing, it's everything.
Home is where your story begins.
The love of a family is life's greatest blessing.
Family: where life begins and love never ends.
In family life, love is the oil that eases friction.
A happy family is but an earlier heaven.
Families are the compass that guides us.
Other things may change us, but we start and end with family.
The memories we make with our family is everything.
Together is a wonderful place to be.
Family is the heart of a home.
Our family is a circle of strength and love.
A family's love is forever.
Side by side or miles apart, family is always close to the heart.
Family means no one gets left behind.
Blood makes you related, love makes you family.
The family is one of nature's masterpieces.
Cherish your family, they are your greatest treasure.
A roof for our heads, a place for our hearts.
Childhood is the most beautiful of all life's seasons.
Children are the rainbow of life.
Every child is a different kind of flower, and all together make this world a beautiful garden.
Let them be little, for they are only young once.
The soul is healed by being with children.
A child's laughter is the most beautiful sound.
Childhood is a short season.
Little hands, little feet, little moments oh so sweet.
Children see magic because they look for it.
The little moments are the big moments.
While we try to teach our children all about life, they teach us what life is all about.
Growing up is optional, growing wise is not.
Today a reader, tomorrow a leader.
Children are the living messages we send to a time we will not see.
Kids don't remember their best day of television.
Childhood lasts a lifetime in your heart.
Be a kid as long as you can.
Tiny humans, enormous joy.
Catching moments before they grow.
And so the adventure begins.
Two hearts, one love, one promise.
Happily ever after starts here.
Love brought them together, and forever they shall stay.
The beginning of forever.
Today I marry my best friend.
A moment, a memory, a lifetime.
From this day forward.
She is the half that makes him whole.
Love is patient, love is kind.
Tale as old as time.
Forever and always.
Two became one.
Where it all began.
To love, to cherish, to begin.
Our forever starts now.
Bound by love, sealed with a kiss.
One love, one heart, one promise.
The greatest of these is love.
The future belongs to those who believe in the beauty of their dreams.
Success is the sum of small efforts repeated day in and day out.
What we achieve inwardly will change outer reality.
The harder you work, the luckier you get.
Dream big, work hard, stay focused.
Believe you can and you're halfway there.
Great things never came from comfort zones.
Hard work beats talent when talent doesn't work hard.
Success is not final, failure is not fatal.
Stars can't shine without darkness.
Well done is better than well said.
The only way to do great work is to love what you do.
Strive for progress, not perfection.
Your only limit is you.
Cap, gown, and a whole lot of dreams.
The journey was worth every step.
She believed she could, so she did.
Proof that dreams come true.
Earned, not given.
In every walk with nature one receives far more than he seeks.
Look deep into nature, and then you will understand everything better.
The earth has music for those who listen.
Adopt the pace of nature: her secret is patience.
Nature does not hurry, yet everything is accomplished.
Keep close to nature's heart.
The mountains are calling and I must go.
Wilderness is not a luxury but a necessity of the human spirit.
And into the forest I go, to lose my mind and find my soul.
Every flower is a soul blossoming in nature.
The sun does not shine for a few trees and flowers, but for the wide world's joy.
Let the beauty of what you love be what you do.
There is a whole world in a single grain of sand.
Nature always wears the colours of the spirit.
Take only memories, leave only footprints.
Of all the paths you take, make sure some are unpaved.
The sea, once it casts its spell, holds one forever.
Sunsets are proof that endings can be beautiful.
Breathe in the wild.
A friend is one soul dwelling in two bodies.
Friends are the family we choose.
Good friends are like stars; you don't always see them but they're always there.
A real friend walks in when the rest of the world walks out.
Friendship is the only cement that will hold the world together.
Side by side or miles apart, friends are always close to the heart.
Walking with a friend in the dark is better than walking alone in the light.
True friendship multiplies the good in life.
The greatest gift of life is friendship.
Friendship doubles our joy and divides our grief.
A good friend knows all your best stories, a best friend has lived them with you.
Many people will walk in and out of your life, but only true friends leave footprints in your heart.
There is nothing on this earth more to be prized than true friendship.
Friends make the good times better and the hard times easier.
Some friendships are forged in a single glance.
Lucky to call you my friend.
Together is our favourite place.
A friend is a gift you give yourself.
Hand in hand, friends understand.
Life isn't measured by the breaths we take, but by the moments that take our breath away.
In the end, we only regret the chances we didn't take.
Collect moments, not things.
The best is yet to come.
Life is what happens when you're busy making other plans.
Enjoy the little things in life.
Live the life you have imagined.
And in that moment, I swear we were infinite.
Happiness is not a destination, it is a way of life.
The good life is one inspired by love and guided by knowledge.
Today is the oldest you've ever been and the youngest you'll ever be again.
Make each day your masterpiece.
Wherever you go, go with all your heart.
Find joy in the journey.
Be the reason someone smiles today.
Adventure is out there.
Savour every ordinary moment.
Do more of what makes you happy.
This is the good stuff.
